test_title: English Language and Comprehension Mock Test 2

questions.question: Identify the most appropriate option that fits the given situation.The young artist's paintings were raw and intense, depicting scenes of violence, despair and ecstasy with unflinching honesty. Her work provoked strong reactions in viewers, some finding it disturbing, others deeply moved.
Select the option that rectifies the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.The team of players confirmed that the victory was not accidentel.
In which of the following situations does the proverb 'fair exchange is no robbery' apply most accurately in a philosophical or ethical context?
options: A poor farmer is forced to sell his land at a low price due to financial pressure.
A collector trades a rare coin for a painting he personally values more.
A thief justifies stealing because he believes he needs the item more.
A company tricks customers into buying a defective product through false advertising.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (A collector trades a rare coin for a painting he personally values more.) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.He has ______ friends.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (a lot of) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that fits the given situation.The detective's investigation had reached a dead end. All leads had dried up, witnesses were uncooperative and the evidence seemed to point incontradictory directions. He felt frustrated and disheartened by the lack of progress.

The explosion released a massive amount of radioactive material into the atmosphere, contaminating vast areas of Europe and causing widespread health problems.B. On 26 April 1986, a catastrophic accident occurred at the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in Ukraine, then part of the Soviet Union.C. The disaster had a profound impact on the global nuclear industry, leading to increased safety measures and a re-evaluation of the risks associated with nuclear power.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.Mahesh and family _____ to the beach tomorrow.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank._____ Taj Mahal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is considered _____ epitome of Mughal architecture.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. The resulting dust storms, known as black blizzards, swept across the plains, causing widespread devastation and economic hardship.B. During the 1930s, a severe drought and unsustainable farming practices led to the Dust Bowl, an ecological disaster that ravaged the Great Plains of the United States.C. Millions of acres of fertile land were turned into barren wasteland, forcing countless families to abandon their homes and livelihoods.D. The Dust Bowl served as a stark reminder of the importance of sustainable land management and the fragile balance between human activity and the environment.E. The federal government responded with a series of initiatives, including soil conservation programs and the establishment of the Soil Conservation Service.
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given proverb.Well begun is half done.
options: Finishing any project is a mammoth task.
Beginning a project well is already half the task.
You can finish a task only if you start early.
A task cannot be done unless it is begun.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Beginning a project well is already half the task.) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.The new policy was intended to mollify the public, but it only seemed to exacerbate the situation.

Comprehension:Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.It is easy to say, ‘Enlarge your vocabulary; first, that you may enter upon the privileges of a cultivated woman; and secondly, that you may be able to tell the truth easily and accurately.’ But it is another and more difficult matter to prescribe the means by which this is to be done. Every girl must, to a large degree, work out her own method. The reading of the best books and conversations with cultivated folk both help in the free use of words. The dictionary is the best friend for your task. Never allow a strange word to pass unchallenged. Usually, it is wise to look it up at the moment. If that is impossible, it must be written firmly to the memory and traced at the first opportunity. It is good to encourage in yourself the habit of dawdling a little over the dictionary. It is the only place where dawdling reaps a harvest. To learn two new words a day – thoroughly to learn them so that their use will not have a foreign accent – is to insure a large vocabulary before you reach middle age.Q76. What are the two means of improving the vocabulary mentioned in the passage?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Reading and conversation) है।
